# [`Pop Quiz 3`](https://umsystem.instructure.com/courses/338371/quizzes/714647)

## `Question 1`

- [ ] `When an IP datagram arrives at a host, which process is responsible for delivering the datagram to the correct transport-layer protocol?`  
- [ ]   `Multiplexing`   
- [ ]   `Application-layer Addressing`   
- [x]   `Demultiplexing`   
- [ ]   `IP routing`

## `Question 2`

`What role does the source port number in a segment header play in multiplexing?`

- [ ]   `Identifies the destination application`   
- [ ]   `Routes the segment to the correct IP address`   
- [x]   `Identifies the sending application`   
- [ ]   `Ensures data integrity`

## `Question 3`

`The transport layer is a logical communication mechanism between application processes running on different host`

- [x]   `True`   
- [ ]   `False`

## `Question 4`

`What is the primary purpose of the UDP checksum?`

- [ ] `To ensure the reliability of data transmission by requesting retransmission of lost packets`   
- [x] `To verify the integrity of the data in the UDP segment and detect any errors during transmission`   
- [ ] `To manage flow control between sender and receiver`   
- [ ] `To establish a connection between the sender and receiver before data transmission`
